data.long_meaning: Johari is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic word 'Jauhar' which means 'God's Gift'. In the Islamic tradition, it is a name given to girls, signifying the belief that every child is a blessing from God. The name Johari carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Johari usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Johari belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Johari total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: יוחרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוחרי הוא שם חסיד שמשמעותו 'האהבה' או 'האהבות'. השם נראה כבר בתקופת בית שני. ישנם חוקרים הטוענים שהשם יוחרי מקורו בלשון הארמית ומשמעותו 'אהבה' או 'אהבות'. יוחרי הוא גם שם משפחה עברי שקיים עד היום.

in_greek.name: Ἰωχαρίς
in_greek.long_meaning: ο Ἰωχαρίς είναι ένα εστιάτορε τοπωνύμιο που σημαίνει 'αγάπη' ή 'αγάπημα'. Existing στο Βιβλίο των Κοιμήσεων (Κοίμησις 1:1-12). Ο Ἰωχαρίς είναι επίσης ένας από τους ονομάτων των αποστόλων. Ο Ἰωχαρίς ήταν ένας από τους οκτώ πρίγκιπες της Δωδεκαπόρου.

in_latin.name: Johari
in_latin.long_meaning: Johari est nomen Christianum quod significat 'caritas', 'amor' vel 'dilectio'. In Evangelio Sancti Matthaei, Johari est unus ex discipulis Domini. Here, Joseph and Mary took the young Jesus to the temple to present him to God and to fulfill the Jewish custom of purification.
